author: KEXP
description: Amsterdam-based outfit Altin Gün return to KEXP with their signature blend of Anatolian psych rock, Turkish folk, and funk. The quintet showcase playful arrangements and fresh melodies with a performance of "Neredesin Sen" and more.
title: Altin Gün performs "Neredesin Sen" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:

Songs:
Gönül Dağı 00:45
Neredesin Sen 04:38
Bir Nazar Eyledim 09:20
